description: This file provides utility functions for file system access and manipulation, including safe path resolution, content encoding/decoding, file copying/moving, and ensuring parent directories exist.

methods.name: Path resolve_safe_path(base_dir: Path, input_path: str)
methods.description: Safely resolves a user-provided path under a specified base directory, preventing path traversal outside the base.

methods.name: str encode_content(data: bytes, encoding: str)
methods.description: Encodes bytes into a string based on the specified encoding such as utf-8, latin-1, base64, or binary.

methods.name: bytes decode_content(text: str, encoding: str)
methods.description: Decodes a string into bytes based on the specified encoding.

methods.name: Tuple[Path,bool] copy_or_move(src: Path, dst: Path, is_move: bool, overwrite: bool)
methods.description: Copies or moves a file or directory to a destination path, with options to overwrite.

methods.name: None ensure_parent_dir(path: Path)
methods.description: Ensures that the parent directory of a given path exists, creating it if necessary.

ctags.name: copy_or_move
ctags.pattern: /^def copy_or_move(src: Path, dst: Path, is_move: bool, overwrite: bool) -> Tuple[Path, bool]:$/
ctags.signature: (src: Path, dst: Path, is_move: bool, overwrite: bool)
